rationale: The exact 533-of-615 overlap is independently reproducible and shows that 86.7 percent of this execution's observed set was already denied before execution. The remaining 82 observations cannot be salvaged because the full bundle failed and they are now exposed. A same-method retry would add exposure without resolving the underlying rediscovery pattern. Terminal closure plus a possible future, separately governed method is the narrowest defensible route that preserves methodological integrity and owner authority.

The 82 pre-execution non-overlaps may appear salvageable descriptively, but the prospective contract prohibits retrospective filtering and the execution exposed them all.
